_comment: Editorial display labels for Leeds proper-noun (PN) lemmas, keyed by Buckwalter lemma. Same standing as assets/root-meanings.js: editorial working labels for navigation, rendered with a ~ Nuanced badge wherever they appear, never presented as Verified, and never expanded by paraphrasing a copyrighted dictionary. latin is a conventional romanization; en is the common English name where one exists. Every key MUST exist in data/name-mentions.json's lemmas (scripts/check-names.mjs enforces it). A lemma not listed here renders from name-mentions.json's ar (the Arabic surface form) with the Buckwalter lemma in the title attribute — never a bare Buckwalter string. Keep entries few and famous; growth is incremental and human-reviewed.
